tool.name: flutter_projects
tool.description: 列出 IDEA 开放项目。服务开关位于 Settings > Tools > Flutter Debug MCP。

tool.name: flutter_sessions
tool.description: 列出 IDEA 已运行 Flutter 会话、设备、运行模式与 VM Service URI。

tool.name: flutter_dtd
tool.description: 获取项目现有 DTD URI；不创建 DTD。ready=false 时地址为空。

projectPath.description: Absolute open project path; required when multiple projects are open.

tool.name: flutter_configurations
tool.description: 列出 Flutter 配置及 id、选中状态；可编辑的应用配置包含 filePath、additionalArgs、attachArgs、buildFlavor、envs（含实际值）及当前 selectedDeviceId。其他 Flutter 配置 editable=false。

projectPath.description: Absolute open project path; required when multiple projects are open.

tool.name: flutter_devices
tool.description: 列出 Flutter 插件发现的已连接设备及 selected 状态；使用返回的精确 id 选择设备。

projectPath.description: Absolute open project path; required when multiple projects are open.

tool.name: flutter_get_configuration
tool.description: 读取单个 Flutter 配置的当前参数；应用配置包含环境变量实际值。

projectPath.description: Absolute open project path; required when multiple projects are open.

configurationId.description: Exact id returned by flutter_configurations; renaming changes this id.

tool.name: flutter_create_configuration
tool.description: 创建并保存 IDEA 原生 Flutter 应用配置，不启动。返回 id 用于后续启动或编辑。

projectPath.description: Absolute open project path; required when multiple projects are open.

name.description: IDEA configuration name; must be unique and nonblank.

filePath.description: Existing Dart entrypoint, absolute or relative to projectPath.

additionalArgs.description: Additional flutter run arguments, exactly as in IDEA. Empty string clears. No shell expansion.

attachArgs.description: Additional flutter attach arguments. Empty string clears.

envs.description: Replaces the entire configured environment map; {} clears it. Omit to preserve. Values may contain secrets.

tool.name: flutter_update_configuration
tool.description: 局部修改并保存 Flutter 应用配置；省略字段保留，空字符串清除可选文本，envs 整体替换。保留执行前任务，不自动重启。重命名后使用返回的新 id。

projectPath.description: Absolute open project path; required when multiple projects are open.

configurationId.description: Exact id returned by flutter_configurations; renaming changes this id.

name.description: IDEA configuration name; must be unique and nonblank.

filePath.description: Existing Dart entrypoint, absolute or relative to projectPath.

additionalArgs.description: Additional flutter run arguments, exactly as in IDEA. Empty string clears. No shell expansion.

attachArgs.description: Additional flutter attach arguments. Empty string clears.

envs.description: Replaces the entire configured environment map; {} clears it. Omit to preserve. Values may contain secrets.

tool.name: flutter_select_device
tool.description: 选择项目 Flutter 工具栏中的已连接设备，不停止或迁移现有会话；之后的启动使用当前选择。

projectPath.description: Absolute open project path; required when multiple projects are open.

deviceId.description: Exact connected device id from flutter_devices.

tool.name: flutter_run
tool.description: 通过 IDEA 配置启动 Flutter，默认 debug，可传 deviceId。返回统一操作状态；应用配置需确认 Flutter started，其他配置只确认进程创建。 默认最多等待5秒，可用waitSeconds调整为0–10秒。返回operationId/status；pending或unknown时用flutter_operation_status查询，不重复提交。锁屏/前后台状态未知，必要时提示用户检查设备及调试暂停。

projectPath.description: Absolute open project path; required when multiple projects are open.

deviceId.description: Optional exact id from flutter_devices; selects the project toolbar device before scheduling launch. Omit to use current selection.

waitSeconds.description: Wait briefly for confirmed completion, default 5 seconds; 0 returns immediately. Pending/unknown operations remain active; poll flutter_operation_status instead of resending.

tool.name: flutter_operation_status
tool.description: 查询 run/rerun/stop/hot_reload/hot_restart 的统一操作状态，无需旧 sessionId。pending=等待中；120秒无结果转为unknown但继续跟踪，后续仍可成功；succeeded/failed=已确认结果。不要因unknown重复调用，先检查设备锁屏、应用前后台、调试器与连接，必要时明确stop再run。记录在MCP停止时清除，最多保留128条，未解决操作优先保留。

tool.name: flutter_hot_reload
tool.description: 通过 IDE 执行 hot reload，收到 Flutter 明确结果才确认完成。 默认最多等待5秒，可用waitSeconds调整为0–10秒。返回operationId/status；pending或unknown时用flutter_operation_status查询，不重复提交。锁屏/前后台状态未知，必要时提示用户检查设备及调试暂停。

sessionId.description: Exact ID from flutter_sessions; rediscover after rerun.

waitSeconds.description: Wait briefly for confirmed completion, default 5 seconds; 0 returns immediately. Pending/unknown operations remain active; poll flutter_operation_status instead of resending.

tool.name: flutter_hot_restart
tool.description: 通过 IDE 执行 hot restart，收到 Flutter 明确结果才确认完成；成功后重新获取 isolate/object ID。 默认最多等待5秒，可用waitSeconds调整为0–10秒。返回operationId/status；pending或unknown时用flutter_operation_status查询，不重复提交。锁屏/前后台状态未知，必要时提示用户检查设备及调试暂停。

sessionId.description: Exact ID from flutter_sessions; rediscover after rerun.

waitSeconds.description: Wait briefly for confirmed completion, default 5 seconds; 0 returns immediately. Pending/unknown operations remain active; poll flutter_operation_status instead of resending.

tool.name: flutter_rerun
tool.description: 停止并重新运行同一 IDEA 配置，跟踪新进程启动。成功后用 flutter_sessions 获取新 sessionId。 默认最多等待5秒，可用waitSeconds调整为0–10秒。返回operationId/status；pending或unknown时用flutter_operation_status查询，不重复提交。锁屏/前后台状态未知，必要时提示用户检查设备及调试暂停。

sessionId.description: Exact ID from flutter_sessions; rediscover after rerun.

waitSeconds.description: Wait briefly for confirmed completion, default 5 seconds; 0 returns immediately. Pending/unknown operations remain active; poll flutter_operation_status instead of resending.

tool.name: flutter_stop
tool.description: 停止指定会话的进程，收到本地进程终止确认才报告 succeeded；不强制杀进程。 默认最多等待5秒，可用waitSeconds调整为0–10秒。返回operationId/status；pending或unknown时用flutter_operation_status查询，不重复提交。锁屏/前后台状态未知，必要时提示用户检查设备及调试暂停。

sessionId.description: Exact ID from flutter_sessions; rediscover after rerun.

waitSeconds.description: Wait briefly for confirmed completion, default 5 seconds; 0 returns immediately. Pending/unknown operations remain active; poll flutter_operation_status instead of resending.
